decisions.reason: The 15-day express program still overlaps with the faster 72-hour and express product line, so it likely falls short of aspirations, but slack and its closeness to the core business make exit only moderately probable.
The 72-hour express delivery has proven to be a competitive differentiator and likely meets or exceeds aspirations, so the firm will keep it with only a small drop probability.
With European approval and homepage prominence, the fire-resistant exterior door clearly exceeds aspirations and will almost certainly be kept.
As a dedicated express product line with several models, it continues to meet broad customer demand and aspirations, so it is retained.
The digital platform is strategically aligned with the firm's shift toward more advisory and service support, and slack allows carrying it despite still-uncertain returns.

The fire and smoke protection door has remained less prominent than the more distinctive fire-rated products, suggesting a persistent shortfall, but slack still argues for keeping it while problemistic search continues.
